raised: The fund's 3.25% and the 2% price rise are only assumptions, so the reader can't tell what the better option is
The '123 מקור / מחושב / הזנתם' legend was confusing and appears before anything has been explained
The 'מה זה' paragraph on basic/extended tracks, with its dates and BANK codes, lost the reader; they couldn't tell whether fees go up or down
'מזומן שקלי' in the bubble meant nothing to the reader
The 'חלק מהבנקים כן משלמים ריבית' box was collapsed, and the reader wanted it open
The second calculator assumes 500 ₪ monthly deposits that the reader doesn't make
The BANK-20/BANK-23 (and other) code tags meant nothing to the reader
'כמה זה עולה' gives no actual number, only 'לפי התעריפון'
Tax lines ('הפיקדון האחרון נחשב כאילו נפדה', '25% מהריבית הריאלית') were confusing
The red box about the low-income exemption being unknown worried the reader
No deposit insurance, and discretionary rather than guaranteed protection, frightened the reader
The age/use-based exemptions aren't calculated, and that is exactly the reader's situation at 61
In 'מונחים', a bar with 'מקור' and buttons sat on top of some of the text
The dotted purple underlines on numbers were unexplained
The reader didn't understand what a קרן כספית is or whether it's as safe as a bank account
The reader didn't understand what 'מנהל מורשה' means if a bank fails
The reader couldn't find whether their own bank pays interest, or Discount's conditions for the 3%
The reader couldn't find what happens to the part of the balance above 10,000 ₪
The reader couldn't find the fund's fees, its taxation, or how to buy one
The reader couldn't find the monthly account fees in shekels
The reader couldn't find whether a big bank is safer than a small one
The reader would cut the securities-loss paragraph as irrelevant
The reader would cut the 'מונחים' list and the footer links

problems.why: The report never mentions field widths, odd placement or oversized fields in the calculator panel on a phone; the only layout complaint is a bar covering text in 'מונחים'.
